            const popupContent = document.getElementById('popup-content');

            // Data structure for interactive content
            const panelData = {
                'a': {
                    title: 'Panel a) - Raw Data',
                    description: 'This panel shows the original scatter plot data without any fitted line. The data points represent input-output pairs that we want to model with a linear function.',
                    points: 10,
                    fitType: 'none'
                },
                'b': {
                    title: 'Panel b) - Poor Fit (High Loss)',
                    description: 'This panel shows a horizontal line fit (y = 0.4) that poorly captures the data trend. The vertical dashed lines show the residuals - the differences between actual and predicted values. Loss = 7.07 indicates a poor fit.',
                    points: 10,
                    fitType: 'horizontal',
                    equation: 'y = 0.4, w = 0.2',
                    loss: 7.07
                },
                'c': {
                    title: 'Panel c) - Wrong Slope (High Loss)',
                    description: 'This panel shows a line with negative slope (y = 1.60 - 0.5x) that goes in the wrong direction compared to the data trend. Despite having a slope, it fits even worse than the horizontal line. Loss = 10.28.',
                    points: 10,
                    fitType: 'negative_slope',
                    equation: 'y = 1.60 - 0.5x',
                    loss: 10.28
                },
                'd': {
                    title: 'Panel d) - Good Fit (Low Loss)',
                    description: 'This panel shows a line with positive slope (y = 0.32 + 0.52x) that closely follows the data trend. The residuals are much smaller, resulting in the lowest loss = 0.20. This demonstrates how the right slope and intercept minimize prediction errors.',
                    points: 10,
                    fitType: 'good_fit',
                    equation: 'y = 0.32 + 0.52x',
                    loss: 0.20
                }
            };

            // Hover effects for data points
            document.querySelectorAll('.data-point').forEach(point => {
                point.addEventListener('mouseenter', (e) => {
                    const x = e.target.getAttribute('data-x');
                    const y = e.target.getAttribute('data-y');
                    
                    // Highlight point
                    e.target.style.stroke = '#333';
                    e.target.style.strokeWidth = '2';
                    e.target.style.r = '4';
                    
                    // Show tooltip
                    tooltip.innerHTML = `Data Point<br/>x = ${x}, y = ${y}`;
                    tooltip.style.display = 'block';
                });

                point.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
                    tooltip.style.left = (e.clientX + 10) + 'px';
                    tooltip.style.top = (e.clientY - 10) + 'px';
                });

                point.addEventListener('mouseleave', (e) => {
                    e.target.style.stroke = 'none';
                    e.target.style.strokeWidth = '0';
                    e.target.style.r = '3';
                    tooltip.style.display = 'none';
                });
            });

            // Hover effects for fit lines
            document.querySelectorAll('.fit-line').forEach(line => {
                line.addEventListener('mouseenter', (e) => {
                    const equation = e.target.getAttribute('data-equation');
                    
                    // Highlight line
                    e.target.style.strokeWidth = '3';
                    e.target.style.stroke = '#e07b30';
                    
                    // Show tooltip
                    tooltip.innerHTML = `Fitted Line<br/>${equation}`;
                    tooltip.style.display = 'block';
                });

                line.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
                    tooltip.style.left = (e.clientX + 10) + 'px';
                    tooltip.style.top = (e.clientY - 10) + 'px';
                });

                line.addEventListener('mouseleave', (e) => {
                    e.target.style.strokeWidth = '2';
                    // Reset to original color
                    if (e.target.getAttribute('data-equation').includes('0.4')) {
                        e.target.style.stroke = '#55bbcc';
                    } else if (e.target.getAttribute('data-equation').includes('1.60')) {
                        e.target.style.stroke = '#999';
                    } else {
                        e.target.style.stroke = '#666';
                    }
                    tooltip.style.display = 'none';
                });
            });

            // Click effects for panels
            document.querySelectorAll('.panel').forEach(panel => {
                panel.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                    const panelId = panel.getAttribute('data-panel');
                    const data = panelData[panelId];
                    
                    // Animate panel highlight
                    panel.style.opacity = '0.8';
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        panel.style.opacity = '1';
                    }, 200);
                    
                    // Show popup
                    popupContent.innerHTML = `
                        <div style="font-weight:600; margin-bottom:6px;">${data.title}</div>
                        <div>${data.description}</div>
                        ${data.fitType !== 'none' ? `<div style="margin-top:8px; font-family:monospace; background:rgba(0,0,0,0.05); padding:4px 6px; border-radius:3px;">Equation: ${data.equation}<br/>Loss: ${data.loss}</div>` : ''}
                    `;
                    popup.style.display = 'block';
                });
            });

            // Animate residual lines on hover
            document.querySelectorAll('[stroke-dasharray="2,2"]').forEach(line => {
                line.addEventListener('mouseenter', (e) => {
                    e.target.style.strokeWidth = '2';
                    e.target.style.stroke = '#e07b30';
                    
                    tooltip.innerHTML = 'Residual<br/>Distance between data point and fitted line';
                    tooltip.style.display = 'block';
                });

                line.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
                    tooltip.style.left = (e.clientX + 10) + 'px';
                    tooltip.style.top = (e.clientY - 10) + 'px';
                });

                line.addEventListener('mouseleave', (e) => {
                    e.target.style.strokeWidth = '1';
                    e.target.style.stroke = '#cc6633';
                    tooltip.style.display = 'none';
                });
            });

            // Close popup
            document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                    popup.style.display = 'none';
                }
            });

            document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                if (!popup.contains(e.target) && !e.target.closest('.panel')) {
                    popup.style.display = 'none';
                }
            });

        } catch (error) {
            console.error('Error in interactive figure:', error);
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>
